## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector participation but extreme concentration in Energy leadership and material mega-cap divergences (multiple tech giants 1W ≠ 1M) support a neutral stance; Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Energy in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND. Financials showing pickup: JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Consumer Staples weak: MNST (1W: -50.28% | 1M: -52.01%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Discretionary soft: HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND, several consumer names in CORRECTION. Materials marginally negative on the week with notable CORRECTION names.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND; VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND; PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND; COP (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +12.35%) ABOVE TREND; CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Energy) — caution on concentration.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: AMZN (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION; FCX (1W: -4.50% | 1M: +13.54%) CORRECTION; RCL (1W: -4.69% | 1M: +3.76%) CORRECTION; HON (1W: -4.69% | 1M: +3.68%) CORRECTION; HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select discretionary and cyclical names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W moves: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND; watch AMZN (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION and CSCO (1W: -8.03% | 1M: +1.84%) CORRECTION as short-term divergences.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but broadly resilient: NVDA (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.56%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +2.68%) ABOVE TREND; however AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: +23.51%) CORRECTION signal intra-sector divergence.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Constructive: JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -0.09%) RECOVERY — Financials add defensive cyclical ballast to the neutral regime.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Generally steady but mixed: JNJ (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +4.15%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +8.43%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -5.11%) BELOW TREND; watch idiosyncratic headline risk in BMY and GILD.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor cyclical/value exposure given Energy leadership and stable Financials while reducing exposure to concentrated tech names showing short-term fracturing; style: Value/Cyclical tilt but remain selective due to narrow leadership and major divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.56%) ABOVE TREND; XOM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +9.70%) ABOVE TREND; CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND; HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (week strong, watch mean reversion on overbought names). BEARISH: Consumer Staples / Discretionary (week weakness, watch MNST and HD).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA near short-term resistance; watch confirmation of ABOVE TREND continuation. CVX breakout continuation level to track for Energy strength. AAPL downside support to monitor as a test of broader tech stability.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
NVDA (+90): Jensen Huang guidance story; price ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming accumulation. BA (+80): FAA approval headline; BA (1W: -1.17% | 1M: +8.09%) CORRECTION — bullish news but short-term pullback (divergence). AMAT (+60): AI tailwind; AMAT (1W: -5.93% | 1M: -9.58%) BELOW TREND — news contrasts with price (distribution risk).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
META (-50): legal/headline risk; META (1W: -0.38% | 1M: -11.24%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming weakness. CSCO (-50): downgrade chatter; CSCO (1W: -8.03% | 1M: +1.84%) CORRECTION — bearish headlines coincident with short-term selloff. HD (-45): transaction weakness; HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Energy leadership and supportive Financials; Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. NVDA (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.56%) ABOVE TREND and CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is narrow leadership and major divergences among mega-caps (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL) plus mixed news signals (e.g., AMAT, BA) — monitor for trend confirmation.
